'''Radek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] that was a patron to the [[Black Dust Tavern]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. The Duros was involved in a bar fight with [[Fenig Nabon]] before the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]] stopped the fight with a [[Calli-Merc blaster pistol]].<ref name="A Credit for Your Thoughts" />
